name: customer-experience
blurb: Interactive photo list with a cursor-following preview that springs to your mouse position.
description: Renders a vertical list of photo items with labels and descriptions. Hovering an item reveals a large preview image that follows cursor movement via spring physics.
use_when: Portfolio or gallery showcases where a dynamic image preview adds engagement.
avoid_when: Mobile-only contexts or when preview images must be stationary.
a11y: Images have alt text. Hover interactions have no keyboard alternative. Preview follows mouse constantly.
